[[File:Galactic Trade Network terminal.png|thumb|Galactic Market Kiosk]]
'''Galactic Market Kiosks''', also known as '''Galactic Trade Network terminals''', or simply '''GTN terminals''', were self-service trade terminals through which an individual could access their account in the [[Galactic Trade Network]], monitoring the state of galactic trade, selling and purchasing all kinds of goods, from [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and animals to everyday supplies. These terminals were widely used during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], and were found in major trade hubs such as market plazas of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
